read.en: Teradyne closed flat on Oct 23 at $308.85, trading between $304.27 and $317.79. It is below the falling 5-day ($327.0), 10-day ($342.7), 30-day ($375.6) and 100-day ($378.9) averages and the rising 200-day ($347.5). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($369.20), and RSI is 33.
read.zh: 泰瑞达 10月23日收平于 $308.85，盘中区间 $304.27–317.79。股价位于下行的 5 日（$327.0）、10 日（$342.7）、30 日（$375.6）和 100 日均线（$378.9）以及上行的 200 日均线（$347.5）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线及零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$369.20），RSI 为 33。

read.en: The $317.8 high faded, leaving the close just under the $309.4 May 19 low, still resistance. Resistance is $309.4–317.8, then $322.3–327 (Oct 20 low, September lows, 5-day) and $331.9 (Oct 15 low). Support is $304.3 (Oct 23 low), then $301–301.9 and $296.8 (spring and July lows). A close below $301 would open $296.8; a close above $317.8 would target $322–327.

r.en: May 19 low, still resistance; Oct 23 high $317.8
r.zh: 5月19日低点，仍为阻力；10月23日高点 $317.8
